Today’s Android app deals and freebies: 20 Minutes Till Dawn, Never Grave, Rush Rally 3, more

By Kamali

A roundup of Google Play discounts that appeared on November 3, 2026, including price cuts on Descenders, Never Grave, Rush Rally 3 and 20 Minutes Till Dawn: Premium, plus a batch of paid apps that were briefly free.

A new batch of Google Play discounts appeared on November 3, 2026, covering paid Android games and apps that were marked down or made free for a limited time. The deals were collected by 9to5Toys, which noted that the offer window has since closed. Because Play Store prices can change without notice, anyone interested should check the current price on the app's store page before buying.

Among the games that got the biggest attention was Rush Rally 3, a mobile rally racing title, which dropped to $1.25 from its regular $3.25. Descenders, an extreme downhill biking game, was cut to $4 from $10. Never Grave, a roguelike action game, fell to $2.50 from $5, and 20 Minutes Till Dawn: Premium, a survival shooter in which players fend off waves of monsters, was listed at $3.50 instead of $5.

Several other titles also saw price cuts. Temporary Neighbor Premium was $2.50, down from $5. Piggy against the World dropped to $2.50 from $4. My Child Lebensborn LITE, a narrative game, was $1.50 instead of $3. Strategy and narrative fans could also find discounts on the Kingdom Rush series, including Kingdom Rush 5: Alliance TD and Kingdom Rush Vengeance, which were each marked down to $1. The Reigns series, This War of Mine and Shotgun King were discounted as well, with This War of Mine falling to $2 from a regular price of $13.

A number of paid apps were available at no cost during the promotion. These included The Room Stalker, Hello Human: AI Puzzle Game, Dungeon Princess 2, Live or Die: Survival Pro, Mekaro: Open World Mech RPG, AimSize: Object Size Measure, SciFi Survivor Premium and the two King of Defense Premium games. Their regular prices ranged from a few cents to a few dollars, and Mekaro and Space Shooter: Galaxy Attack had regular prices of $7 and $22 respectively, which makes the free offers more notable.

Outside of games, SkySafari 8 Pro, an astronomy app, was reduced to $35 from $50, and SkySafari Astronomy fell to $5 from $7. Helmet Icon Pack was also available for $0.75.

The roundup also referred readers to other hardware deals that were running at the time, including an all-time low on the new Google Home Speaker during an early Black Friday sale, as well as price cuts on Pixel 11 phones and a first deal on Amazon's new Alexa Android tablet.

A few cautions apply. Price drops on Google Play usually last only a short time, and developers can end them early or extend them. Regional pricing also varies, so the amounts quoted here are U.S. dollar prices and may differ in other countries. Free-for-a-limited-time apps typically stay in a user's library after being claimed, but the terms depend on the developer, so it is worth reading the store listing first. As Black Friday approaches, more app and hardware discounts are likely to appear.
